copy_lock.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.

The date began with one missing key
and two suspects.

By the third wrong turn,
nobody was cute anymore.

“Don’t talk to me.”

He gave her the minute.
Not the distance.

It wasn’t really the wrong turn.

They had simply missed each other
for too many ordinary days.

The plan failed.
The date didn’t.

He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.

agents.prompt_summary: Extract visual mechanics from references without copying frames, likenesses, or exact labels.
Prove every locked slide through concrete Aachu/Zuv behavior, not decorative illustration.
Define wants, hidden needs, eye-lines, hands, posture, distance, and joke-to-tenderness movement.
Plan readable text and brandmark placement independently for every request-locked native output.
Translate the selected visual system into specific final-generation and integrated-text constraints.
Select one system only after scoring copy alignment, relationship proof, visual variety, identity, aspect safety, and sendability.

visual_system_candidates.case_for: Protects eye-lines, hands, distance, and emotional reversal.

cross_debate: Keep the approved copy locked and make visuals do proof work.
Reject decorative quote-card scenes, generic couple stock poses, and repeated props.
Preserve the selected visual system unless visual-plan-quality records an explicit repair.
why_it_wins: Slide-Led Evidence Plan wins because it keeps the visual system accountable to the selected story arc.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Rain-damp evening beside a tiny roadside chai stall. Exactly Aachu and Zuv stand under one umbrella beside their modest dark car, safely parked on the quieter service lane away from traffic, dressed for a proper date. Across the divided road, through moving cars, the intended restaurant on the next road is visibly close but inconvenient to reach. The chai stall glows immediately beside them. Aachu points toward the chai stall with her right hand while her left hand stays relaxed at her side. Zuv holds the umbrella in his right hand and lowers the phone map in his left; they exchange a small conspiratorial 'shall we?' look. This is the decision before the accidental date, not the seated payoff. No chai vendor or background people visible.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Nonlinear callback before departure, entirely OUTSIDE the apartment in a pristine dry corridor. Medium-wide, nearly straight-on full-body view. The fully closed front door is centered; its single exterior lever handle is on the RIGHT edge beside Zuv. The elevator is on frame left behind Aachu, but its two doors are already 80 percent closed: show only one narrow dark vertical seam, never an open cabin or visible elevator interior. The call button glows beside it. Exactly two people stand on one depth plane, Zuv slightly taller and broader than Aachu. Zuv has stayed at the closed door to check it; his hips, shoes, and torso remain square to the door rather than turning from the elevator. He stands immediately beside the handle and visibly wraps his anatomical RIGHT hand around the exterior lever, depressing it downward under clear testing tension. His LEFT arm and hand stay naturally hidden behind his own back, never crossed or pocketed. Aachu had already taken a step toward the elevator and is the only person who turns back. She stands on the door's left half with her left foot still pointing toward the nearly closed elevator, her lifted right heel stepping back toward the apartment, and three tiny fading graphite motion ticks tracing the short return from elevator threshold to heel. She performs a clearly forceful push-test on the closed center-left door panel, well away from Zuv's handle hand: her visible anatomical RIGHT palm lies flat, her elbow is locked straight, her shoulder and upper torso lean their weight into that arm, her shirt sleeve compresses at the shoulder, and two tiny graphite pressure ticks touch the panel beside her palm. Her whole right arm stays continuously readable. Her left hand stays hidden by the tote on her shoulder and tightly rolled bone-dry umbrella under her arm. One forearm of clear air remains between their torsos: no touch, lean, hug, waist hold, or overlap. Zuv looks at his handle grip and Aachu looks at her palm contact; neither looks at the other or viewer. Both wear small private smiles. Aachu must retain her reference identity: warm fair-medium skin, soft oval-to-round face with fuller cheeks and lips, expressive dark eyes and brows, and long mostly straight center-parted dark hair, never pointed or sharply narrow and never tousled into strong waves. She wears the reference white shirt, blue jeans, and red pointed flats. Zuv must retain his reference identity: warm medium-brown skin, broad rounded-oval face, thick brows, defined nose, fuller trimmed beard and moustache, and dense dark hair brushed up into broad swept waves, never tight curls or ringlets. He wears the reference pale blue embroidered shirt, loose grey trousers, and red-black shoes. Clothes, shoes, umbrella, hair, and floor are pristine and dry. Both participate in one functional push-pull check through two separate simultaneous contacts: he tests the handle while she has gone back and adds a weighted panel push. No casual resting palm, visible key or fob, interior, open door, open elevator cabin, post-date return, rain marks, folded or pocketed arms, untouched handle, solo checker, mutual glamour gaze, arrows, labels, ghost bodies, scooter, motorbike, or helmets.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.
